# Vaquill

> Vaquill is US primary law data infrastructure, delivered through a REST API, an MCP server and SQL over an object store. Every result carries a citation, full text and a link to the official government source.

Base URL: https://api.vaquill.ai. Authenticate every request with `Authorization: Bearer vq_key_...`. Coverage and counts live on the [Coverage](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/coverage) page.

## Data coverage

- [Coverage](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/coverage): Which US jurisdictions and corpus types the Vaquill API covers, with section counts and how often each is updated
- [Federal coverage](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/coverage/federal): Every federal corpus the statutes API serves, with refresh cadence, corpusType tokens and what each one holds
- [Treaty coverage](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/coverage/treaties): The two treaty corpus tokens: US_TAX_TREATY for IRS income tax treaties, US_TREATY for treaty text and the Senate treaty record
- [State and territory coverage](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/coverage/states): Per-jurisdiction coverage of state and territory statutes, regulations, constitutions, court rules, registers and agency guidance
- [Federal agency guidance sources](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/coverage/agency-guidance): Sub-regulatory federal guidance sources, each filterable with corpusType=AGENCY_GUIDANCE and source
- [State session laws](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/session-laws): State session laws as enacted, with dates, veto outcome, sources, text and search
- [US rulemaking](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/rulemaking): Regulations.gov dockets and documents, Unified Agenda history, OIRA review and CRA links, tied together by the RIN

## Core concepts

- [How search works](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/search): How hybrid ranking, matchType and filters work, and why search ranks rather than enumerates
- [Boolean search](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/boolean-search): Search with AND, OR, NOT, proximity and wildcards using matchType boolean.
- [Corpus types](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/corpus-types): What each corpusType token covers, which tokens need a state, and how source narrows a token.
- [Jurisdictions and state codes](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/jurisdictions): The jurisdictions the API accepts, how state codes work, and how to see what each one holds.
- [Hierarchy and container names](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/hierarchy): What a title, chapter, part or article is, which fields carry its name, and how to read breadcrumb and displayPath.
- [Section identifiers](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/section-ids): The actId section identifier, how it behaves over time, and how to go from search to metadata, full text and neighbors
- [Response fields](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/response-fields): Which fields a section carries, which corpus each one belongs to, and how to tell 'not applicable' from 'we do not have it'
- [Response formats](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/formats): The text formats the body endpoint returns, and the source URL fields that link back to official text
- [Citation formats](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/citation-formats): Which citation strings resolve, why the form your state prints is the safest to send, and which forms are refused on purpose.
- [Pinpoints](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/pinpoints): Get the text of one subsection, paragraph or clause instead of the whole section, and learn how far to trust it.
- [Citation resolution quality](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/citation-quality): How reliably GET and POST /us/statutes/resolve read citations, and which citations are refused on purpose.
- [Section intelligence](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/section-intelligence): Four routes about a section you already hold: what cites it, what its terms mean, how other states word it, what changed.
- [Point-in-time law](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/point-in-time): Get the text of a US provision as it read on a past date.
- [Status and currency](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/status-and-currency): Tell whether a section is still good law: actStatus, goodLawStatus, filtering on both, and move pointers.
- [Amendment history](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/concepts/amendment-history): When a section changed, from the publisher's credit line: amendmentYears, lastAmendedYear, amendmentsCount and amendmentHistory.

## Guides

- [Grounding LLMs with Vaquill AI](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/grounding-llms): How to ground model answers in retrieved US statutory text
- [Law change alerts](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/alerts): Subscribe to a jurisdiction or corpus and get a webhook or email when it changes, with the exact sections that changed
- [Pagination](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/pagination): Offset paging and cursor paging, and which endpoints use which
- [Best practices](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/best-practices): Scoping, matching, caching and retry habits for production use of the API

## Recipes

- [Ground an LLM answer in statutes (RAG)](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/recipes/rag-grounding): Retrieve US statutes and regulations, then make an LLM answer only from that text, with links to the official source
- [Build a statute lookup chatbot](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/recipes/statute-chatbot): A minimal question-and-answer loop that searches US statutes, pulls the governing section, and replies with a cited answer
- [Resolve and verify a statute citation](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/recipes/citation-lookup): Resolve a statute or regulation citation to its governing section, and check a whole document's citations in one batch call
- [Get one subsection](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/recipes/pinpoint-subsection): Get the text of one subsection from a citation like 625 ILCS 5/11-601(c)
- [Browse the statute hierarchy](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/recipes/browse-hierarchy): Walk a code top to bottom with /us/statutes/divisions: titles, chapters, parts, articles, rule sets and sections in statutory order
- [Build a subject corpus](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/recipes/subject-corpus): Assemble every statute and regulation on one subject across jurisdictions, then keep it current
- [Map a compliance requirement to the governing law](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/recipes/compliance-mapping): Turn a plain-language obligation into governing sections, grouped by jurisdiction, with citations and official source links
- [Compare a rule across states](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/recipes/multi-state-comparison): Find the comparable provision in other states from one section, or run one multi-state search, instead of a search per state
- [Monitor corpus coverage and changes](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/recipes/coverage-monitoring): Poll changedSince for sections that moved since your last sync, and diff coverage snapshots to catch a new corpus in a jurisdiction
- [Enrich a citation database with source text](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/recipes/citation-enrichment): Batch-resolve a column of citations, search the topic-only rows, and attach a canonical citation, excerpt and official source URL
- [Add the corpus as an AI agent tool (MCP)](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/recipes/mcp-tool): Give an AI agent authoritative statute search, either through the hosted Vaquill MCP server or by wrapping the REST API as your own tool

## Bulk data and licensing

- [Bulk and SQL access](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/bulk-and-sql): Query the US primary-law corpus as a database: Parquet snapshots readable over HTTPS with DuckDB, or loaded into Postgres.
- [Rights and licensing](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/rights-and-licensing): What you may do with the data: cache it, build indexes, show it to your users, redistribute it, and what you keep if you stop paying.

## Reference

- [Errors and rate limits](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/errors): Status codes, the error body, 400 versus 422 and how to handle rate limits on the Data API
- [Error code reference](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/errors/codes): Every machine-readable error code the Data API returns, with its status, retry rule, SDK class and what to do.
- [FAQ](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/faq): Short answers to common integration questions, with links to the page that covers each one.
- [Data and privacy](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/data-privacy): What the Vaquill API stores about your requests, who processes them, and how to use it with sensitive client matters.

## Legislation

- [India legislation coverage](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/coverage/india): What the India legislation API covers, its amendment and repeal data, and the routes you can call.
- [Legal translation](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/translation): Translate legal text and documents between English and the 22 Eighth Schedule languages. Billed in pages, from a pool of its own.

## Regulatory publications

- [India regulatory publications quickstart](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/india-regulatory-quickstart): Find an Indian regulator's circular, read it, and follow what changes, in five requests
- [India regulatory publications coverage](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/coverage/india-regulatory): What the India regulatory publications corpus holds: documents issued by Indian regulators and courts, and the routes to read them.

## Case law

- [India case law quickstart](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/india-case-law-quickstart): Find an Indian Supreme Court or High Court judgment, read it, and resolve a citation to it, in six requests
- [India case law coverage](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/coverage/india-case-law): What the India case law corpus holds: Supreme Court and High Court judgments, the courts covered, and the routes to read them.

## Tribunals

- [India tribunals quickstart](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/india-tribunals-quickstart): Find a matter before an Indian tribunal, read it, check its orders and fetch its document, in six requests
- [India tribunals coverage](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-guide/coverage/india-tribunals): What the India tribunals corpus holds: matters before 15 Indian forums, the forums covered, and the routes to read them.

## Integrations

- [Integrations](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/integrations/index): MCP servers and automation templates that connect Vaquill AI to the tools you already use.

## MCP servers

- [MCP Servers](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/integrations/mcp/index): Connect Vaquill AI's US primary-law corpus to Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and any other MCP client.
- [Vaquill MCP Server](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/integrations/mcp/vaquill): Read-only US primary law MCP server for Claude, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf, set up with your Vaquill API key.
- [Claude Connector](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/integrations/mcp/claude-connector): Connect US primary law to Claude with a Connect button. OAuth sign-in, no API key, and the only path that works in Cowork.
- [Claude Code Plugin](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/integrations/mcp/claude-plugin): The primary-law plugin for Claude Code: ten research commands, a US statute research skill and the Vaquill MCP server.
- [ChatGPT and Codex](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/integrations/mcp/chatgpt): Connect US primary law to ChatGPT and Codex over MCP. Use the search and fetch tools with OAuth sign-in and no API key.

## Automation

- [n8n and Make.com](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/integrations/automation/n8n): Pre-built n8n and Make.com templates that read statute queries from a Google Sheet and write matching sections back.

## API reference

- [Search US statutes](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-reference/us-statutes/search-us-statutes-constitutions-court-rules-and-executive-actions): POST /api/v1/us/statutes/search.
- [Get statute section metadata](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-reference/us-statutes/get-statute-section-metadata): GET /api/v1/us/statutes/section/{act_id}.
- [Get statute full text](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-reference/us-statutes/get-statute-full-text): GET /api/v1/us/statutes/section/{act_id}/body.
- [Get metadata for many statute sections](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-reference/us-statutes/get-metadata-for-many-statute-sections): POST /api/v1/us/statutes/sections.
- [Resolve a citation to its section](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-reference/us-statutes/resolve-a-citation-to-its-section): GET /api/v1/us/statutes/resolve.
- [Get the sections around this one](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-reference/us-statutes/get-the-sections-around-this-one): GET /api/v1/us/statutes/section/{act_id}/related.
- [Coverage matrix by jurisdiction and corpusType](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-reference/us-statutes/coverage-matrix-by-jurisdiction-and-corpustype): GET /api/v1/us/statutes/coverage.
- [Browse the statutory hierarchy](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-reference/us-statutes/browse-the-statutory-hierarchy): GET /api/v1/us/statutes/divisions.
- [List watchable boards](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-reference/board-watches/list-watchable-boards): GET /api/v1/boards, the entry point for the free law-change alert endpoints.
- [Get API credit pricing](https://www.vaquill.ai/docs/api-reference/pricing/get-api-credit-pricing): GET /api/v1/api-credits/pricing, public and unauthenticated.
- [OpenAPI schema (US)](https://api.vaquill.ai/external/openapi.json): Machine-readable spec for all public US endpoints.
